anomalies.description: A group of men surrounds a prone, injured man on the ground; one man holds a sword or dagger near the victim's neck/chest while others restrain or press down on him, indicating an attack on a helpless victim.

A group of men surrounds and physically assaults a prone, injured man lying on the ground; one man holds a sword or dagger near the victim's neck/face while others restrain him, consistent with sustained abuse of a helpless individual.
A group of men surrounds a wounded, supine man on the ground; one man holds a spear-like object near his neck while others restrain him, indicating an attack on a helpless victim.
The wounded man struggles upward while being held by multiple assailants; physical resistance and active restraint suggest mutual combat or violent struggle during the assault.

After the struggle, the man is pushed back down and appears to be struck or choked; he is then seen rising unsteadily while still surrounded by hostile individuals, consistent with ongoing abuse of a vulnerable person.
